set.description: 焦点在 x 轴上时，椭圆标准方程是 x²/a²+y²/b²=1，其中 a>b>0。
set.name: Standard equation of an ellipse

criteria: Identify the absolute difference of the two focal distances.
Require 0<constant<focal separation for a nondegenerate hyperbola.
set.description: A nondegenerate hyperbola is the locus of points whose absolute difference of distances to two distinct foci is a fixed positive constant strictly smaller than the focal separation. Zero difference gives the perpendicular bisector, not a hyperbola.
set.name: Definition of a Hyperbola

set.reason: This factoring method is the difference-of-squares identity read from right to left; its structure is the operation's basis.
set.scope: Recognizing difference of squares structure

set.reason: The difference-of-squares method must return a factorized product rather than merely another expanded expression.
set.scope: Recognizing a complete factorization

set.reason: The output must be a product/perfect square equivalent to the polynomial, using factorization meaning.
set.scope: Recognizing the goal of factoring

set.reason: Reading/writing standard form uses circle center and radius concepts.
set.scope: center and radius as equation parameters

set.reason: The circle equation expresses a fixed Cartesian distance from its center.
set.scope: why the equation describes the circle

set.reason: The criterion expressly distinguishes hyperbola and ellipse standard forms. Knowing the ellipse form is part of that comparison, even though it is not needed merely to read a given hyperbola equation.
set.scope: distinguishing hyperbola equations from ellipse equations

set.reason: The standard equation's foci and parameter c refer to the two fixed foci in the hyperbola definition; only that definitional content is required.
set.scope: meaning of a, c and foci in standard equation

criteria: 能识别平方差结构
分解彻底
set.description: a²-b²=(a+b)(a-b)，把符合平方差结构的多项式因式分解。
set.name: Formula Method: Difference of Squares

criteria: 能由圆心和半径写标准方程
能从标准方程读出圆心和半径
set.description: 圆心为 (a，b)、半径为 r 的圆，方程是 (x−a)²+(y−b)²=r²。
set.name: Standard Equation of a Circle

criteria: 能写出焦点在 x 轴上的标准方程
能从方程区分椭圆和双曲线
set.description: 焦点在 x 轴上时，双曲线标准方程是 x²/a²−y²/b²=1。
set.name: Standard Equation of a Hyperbola

criteria: 能判断是否是完全平方式
能正确分解
set.description: a²±2ab+b²=(a±b)²，识别完全平方式。
set.name: Formula Method: Perfect Squares

criteria: 能区分平方根与算术平方根
会用符号 √a 和 ±√a
set.description: 如果 x²=a（a≥0）则 x 叫 a 的平方根，正的平方根叫算术平方根，正数有两个互为相反数的平方根，0 的平方根为 0，负数没有平方根。
set.name: Square Roots and Principal Square Roots

criteria: 能识别平方差结构
能用于简便计算
set.description: (a+b)(a-b)=a²-b²，抓住“相同项”与“相反项”。
set.name: Difference of Squares Formula

criteria: 能判断是否是因式分解
能说出与乘法的关系
set.description: 把一个多项式化为几个整式的积叫因式分解，它与整式乘法互为逆运算。
set.name: Concept of Factorization

criteria: 能指出圆的各元素
能说明直径是最长的弦
set.description: 认识圆、圆心、半径、弦、直径、弧、半圆、圆心角及等圆等概念。
set.name: Basic Concepts of Circles

criteria: 能用两点距离公式计算
知道公式是勾股定理
set.description: 平面上两点的距离等于横、纵坐标之差的平方和的算术平方根。
set.name: Distance between two points
